name: Frederick 'Freddie' Smith
bio: Robert Ross's companion for a decade. Fryer records that Ross met him early in 1903, when Smith was an eighteen-year-old clerk and Ross almost twice his age; he became Ross's secretary, a position that also served as cover, and in 1906 moved into 15 Vicarage Gardens over his family's objections. He acted on the amateur stage as 'F. Stanley Smith'. The relationship ended in the autumn of 1913, and in 1914 he was named in Lord Alfred Douglas's plea of justification, where witnesses testified to having seen Ross embrace him.
bio_note: All facts from Jonathan Fryer, Robbie Ross (2000), transcribed and verified at rendered pages. Birth and death dates are not given by Fryer: he states only that Smith was eighteen early in 1903, which would place his birth about 1884-85 - an inference, deliberately not entered in the born field. Note on His origins: Cook, Queer Domesticities (2014), printed p. 100, states that Smith left George Ives's household to move in with Ross. Cook cites nothing for it - the sentence carries no note marker, and the nearest endnote (21, printed p. 271) is methodological literature on household and family. Fryer, who documents Smith abundantly, never mentions Ives in connection with him, and the dates sit awkwardly (Cook puts the Adelaide Road household from 1905; Fryer has Smith with Ross from early 1903). Dates: none recorded; confirmed again so far. Fryer's first-mention passage, printed p. 177 (PDF 199), is as close as the biography comes: 'early in 1903, he met a young man with whom he entered into a relationship quite unlike his other brief encounters with boys. Every later mention (printed pp. 192, 193, 198, 200, 207, 214, 230, 237, 238; PDF 214, 215, 220, 222, 229, 236, 252, 259, 260 - Fryer's second-half offset is printed = PDF minus 22) is narrative and dateless. Murray, Bosie (2020), PDF, contains no Freddie Smith at all - every 'Freddie' there is Freddie Manners-Sutton, the Crosland prosecutor, a different man entirely, and the two should not be conflated. Also searched: the Complete Letters mirror and Cook, Queer Domesticities (2014). No birth or death date is recorded in any source consulted; the age eighteen in early 1903 would put his birth about 1884-85 and is still not entered.
